Services and Capabilities

Molded cables.

ARNIR’s factories are equipped with advanced machinery and tools for molding as part of our cable assembly production capabilities.

Our capabilities

Molding, on the same floor
as the rest of the assembly.

Our molding capabilities, combined with cutting, stripping, crimping, soldering, and electrical and mechanical testing, enable us to produce cable assemblies with exceptional accuracy and efficiency.

Industrial power cables, molded cables, and industrial wire harnesses produced in our factories are installed and used in the telecommunications sector around the world.

Quality

Built under stringent
quality control.

Our fully assembled telecommunication and industrial applications are manufactured under stringent quality control measures to ensure that every product we produce meets the highest standards of performance and durability.
